title: Morning Rounds — scrub seam and a clean clipboard grip

steps.headline: The red scrub edges meet closer to the mouth, with a dark seam and longer sleeves.
steps.changed: The extra cream triangle is gone. Red comes higher beside the muzzle, a short dark line divides the scrub front, and red sleeves cover more of both arms.
steps.notice: Check the neckline and whether the lower arms still read as paws.

steps.path: The clipboard at its right hand
steps.headline: The square-looking beige finger is gone from the clipboard.
steps.changed: The same upright board now paints behind the original arm; no extra tan finger is drawn over it.
steps.notice: Does it still look held, without the pasted-on square?

steps.path: The welcome face at its 80-pixel display size
steps.headline: See the whole dog at the size you approved in the last round.
steps.changed: This compares the last revision with the new neckline, sleeves, seam and hand treatment at 80 pixels.
steps.notice: Judge whether the overall character still feels friendly.
steps.risk: This is static flat art; motion is not shown.
